description.en-Latn-US: Activity bank for the READ 1000 Temperance Module (Module 1). Holds the Main Content screens the study-group conversation pulls into the right-hand panel — the vocabulary self-check, Professor Hale's brief background lecture, the American Yawp textbook excerpt (revealed in three chunks), the note-checking table, the close-reading / grammar highlighting tasks, the reading-comprehension check, the note-organizing task, and the magazine article — plus the vocabulary, Benevolent Empire, and article questions that appear inline in the chat. Launchable so it can be previewed and edited on its own.

READ 1000 — Module 1 (FULL SBA): the complete version of the Temperance Module, extending the storyboard's authored portion all the way through the parts it left 'in progress'. Across five parts, a study group (peers Danielle, Joe, Karis; reading instructor Professor Booker) works through three texts — an American Yawp textbook excerpt, a magazine article, and N. Currier's 1846 lithograph 'The Drunkard's Progress' — building toward a short COMPARISON ESSAY by rating vocabulary, close-reading and highlighting, checking a peer's notes, answering comprehension questions, organizing notes, and analyzing the image, then finally writing a short essay that compares the historic temperance movement (the 1800s) with today's approaches to drinking less. Two-pane design: a scripted conversation on the left and a tabbed panel (Main Content / Textbook / Your Notes / Your Essay) on the right. Companion to the storyboard-faithful build (sba/temperance_module_sba).
